The drawing contains conflicting information regarding heat treatment:

*   The title block heat treatment field is marked '---' [TB:heat_treatment].
*   Note N3 specifies: "TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC" with a "CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm" and notes that "THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT" [N3].

Finding F10 flags this contradiction as a warning, noting that the title block suggests no treatment while note N3 requires case hardening [F10].
